methodology.before: One clean full-suite run and one clean real LocalStore run before edits.
methodology.after: Median of three clean runs after edits; higher throughput is better.
methodology.selection: CPU profile plus measured hot-path benchmark rows. Protocol parsing was profiled but left unchanged because same-process A/B results were within noise.
methodology.limitations: Single-machine microbenchmarks; no claim of proportional production latency improvement.

optimizations.name: redact_strings
optimizations.change: Added a necessary-condition prefilter and per-rule hints so benign text avoids eighteen secret regex scans and secret-bearing text scans only relevant rules. ASCII entropy counting uses a fixed table; Unicode behavior is unchanged.
optimizations.safety: Default and custom-rule paths are differentially tested; the full planted-secret corpus and generated-text equivalence checks must pass.

optimizations.name: hook_path_enqueue
optimizations.change: Benefits from the redaction fast path without weakening envelope or payload validation.
optimizations.safety: Protocol parsing remains Zod-based and unchanged.

optimizations.name: local_store_batch_insert
optimizations.change: Replaced per-row INSERT statements with cached multi-row INSERT OR IGNORE statements in bounded chunks while preserving one transaction per batch.
optimizations.safety: Mixed 205-row chunk-boundary, duplicate, and forced-outbox-failure rollback tests must pass.
